observations: The public client route manifest has no player combat/kill-history page.
The public API documentation has 82 entries and does not document kill-history or leaderboard/kills.
The dungeon and leaderboard clients consume summaries plus transient contribution_kill events, not an archived history query.
filter=Sentinel, filter=sentinel and filter=32 each return Krutch all-enemy totals (27445), despite echoing the supplied filter.
Hunting exposes a real paginated archive of drop-roll events, but its page explicitly excludes combat dungeon/boss kills. enemyType=32 and limit=1 were ignored by that endpoint.
regionId=9 narrows the dungeon entrance list but leaves the Feral Sentinel aggregate at the global total.
No public Bitjita application repository was found among the inspected BitJita organization repositories; its issues repository has no matching history-access discussion.
conclusion: Public summary and transient event access confirmed; no usable historical Sentinel archive or player-specific Sentinel count found. Negative probes do not establish that no private archive or untested public route exists.
